task: fix(omnimux): 修复三栏布局竞争与全屏状态失衡缺陷，收敛伪全屏并保护会话物理宽度
verifiedBy: CDP Live Renderer & JSDOM E2E Suite

findings.issue_1_fake_fullscreen: resolveDefaultFocus previously returned WORKBENCH_FOCUS.gui which forcibly collapsed conversation column to 0px while host remained in push mode.
findings.fix_1_default_split: resolveDefaultFocus converged to WORKBENCH_FOCUS.split across all tabs including workflow library, assets, etc.
findings.issue_2_text_leakage: conversation-collapse CSS previously had overflow:visible !important and opacity:1 !important which leaked welcome text at left bottom.
findings.fix_2_overflow_hidden: conversation-collapse CSS strictly enforces overflow:hidden !important and opacity:0 !important on folded conversation column.
findings.issue_3_black_dead_zone: on exit fullscreen, conversation column lacked positive minimum width and flex fill, causing large black hole gap.
findings.fix_3_min_width_protection: conversation-box CSS guarantees min-width: 420px !important and flex: 1 1 0% !important during normal split/non-fullscreen layout.
